title: Core and discrete laws
content: The 3 panels, the generator and the workers, the expression language and the model record. The expert editor and the examples. The 10 discrete laws, 3 methods to draw samples, the core diagnostics and the exports.

title: Continuous laws and variance reduction
content: Uniform, normal, multivariate normal, exponential, gamma, Erlang, beta, Dirichlet, chi-square, Student's t, F, logistic and Laplace. Stratification, antithetic variables, control variates and common random numbers.

title: Positive, heavy-tailed and extreme-value laws
content: Lognormal, Weibull, inverse Gaussian, Gompertz, log-logistic, Pareto I and II, Burr XII, Fréchet, Cauchy, Lévy and stable laws. The generalised extreme value (GEV), generalised Pareto (GPD), Gumbel and reverse Weibull laws. Censored observations, tail plots and the theory of extremes.

title: Constructed laws and custom inputs
content: Finite mixtures, compound Poisson, empirical and kernel density models, truncated laws, and custom PDF, PMF, CDF, quantile, MGF and characteristic function inputs with their checks.

title: Dependence and processes
content: Conditional models, and the Gaussian, Student-t, Clayton, Gumbel and Frank copulas. Finite-state Markov chains, Brownian motion, Ornstein–Uhlenbeck (OU), Poisson, Hawkes, branching and Lévy processes. Multilevel Monte Carlo.

title: The guided interview
content: A rule graph that asks about the problem and proposes candidate models, with reasons, other explanations and rejection tests.

title: Rare events and ruin
content: Valid exponential tilting, splitting, subset simulation, adaptive importance sampling, the cross-entropy method, and the catastrophe and ruin test.

title: Markov chains, sequential and quasi-Monte Carlo
content: Metropolis–Hastings, Gibbs, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, sequential Monte Carlo, particle filters and randomised quasi-Monte Carlo.

title: Critical behaviour
content: An energy landscape, annealing and tempering, a sandpile, finite-size scaling and coarse-graining.

title: Local data and the acceptance gate
content: CSV and JSON import, estimation, bootstrap methods, tail-threshold selection and the final acceptance gate.
